why: GIF downloads: allowed() admits only the configured provider's protocol and media hosts with no credentials, and fetch uses redirect: 'manual', a 15 s timeout and a 10 MB cap. CodeQL does not model the host allowlist as a sanitizer. Reviewed 2026-11-15.

/shell.json: the list of the app's own file paths (server/shell.js shellList, read from the app directory) sent as JSON.stringify with Content-Type application/json and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff from the shared headers; never HTML. Reviewed 2026-11-16.
